model: LightLEEDer BACnet IP panel-level interface (SMD point map)
applies_to: Intelligent Lighting Controls LightLEEDer panel-level BACnet IP interface (older point scheme with SMD_ point names).
summary: Panel-level BACnet IP point map for a LightLEEDer lighting panel. Binary Outputs give status and control of 64 relays (on/off and on/blink), 48 relay groups (on/off and on/blink) and 48 presets; Analog Outputs read LightSync device inputs and photocells, set and read dimmer outputs, run motor outputs and disable individual LightSync devices.
notes: The map prints types as DO and AO; they are listed here as Binary Output and Analog Output.
Several AOs work as an index/value pair: write the device number first (AO 1, 5, 15), then read or write the related values.
Motor control time is split over MSByte (AO 20-23) and LSByte (AO 24-27) objects.
Access is not printed; outputs are taken as writable (access inferred).

source.title: LightLEEDer BACnet IP Panel Level Point Map

integration.summary: Command relays (BO 1-64), groups (BO 129-176) or presets (BO 225-272) and read back their status from the same objects.
gotchas: Each relay and group has two objects, on/off (BO 1-64, 129-176) and on/blink (BO 65-128, 177-224); map the one that matches the control you want.
